description: Check a Sage connection by actually READING from it — one customer record. There are two separate connectors: version='sage100' (Sage 100 Germany, SData over a per-installation server, OpenID Connect) and version='sage_business_cloud' (Sage Business Cloud Accounting v3.1, one REST base, OAuth2 with FIVE-MINUTE tokens). A test that only fetches a token proves nothing about whether the credentials may read anything, so this one performs a real query. Note: no Sage account exists for this project yet, so the HTTP path itself is unmeasured — the answer says so.

version.description: Sage connector to test: Sage 100 or Sage Business Cloud

name: test_sage_connection
